incident.title: Payment authorisation failures
incident.alert_or_symptom: Customers are unable to complete card payments.

technical_evidence.observation: Success rate fell from 97 percent to 4 percent at 10:15.
Requests to the external payment gateway return HTTP 503.
The local payment application and transaction database are healthy.

service_impact.user_impact_description: Customers using card payments cannot complete purchases.

environmental_context: The Payment Processing Service depends on the External Payment Gateway.
The local payment application and database are currently healthy.
reported_unknowns: The geographical scope has not been confirmed.
No approved payment workaround has yet been confirmed.

model_output.incident_summary: Customers are unable to complete card payments due to external payment gateway failures, impacting a critical service.

severity.rationale: The Payment Processing Service is unavailable due to an external dependency failure. This impacts a business-critical service with significant user impact.

incident_category.rationale: The Payment Processing Service is completely unavailable due to an external dependency failure.

affected_area.rationale: The external payment gateway is unavailable, directly impacting the Payment Processing Service.

routing.rationale: The Payments and Integrations Team is primarily responsible for the Payment Processing Service, while cross-team coordination may be required due to the critical nature of the incident.

initial_actions.rationale: This will provide insights into why the external payment gateway is failing and how it impacts the Payment Processing Service.

initial_actions.rationale: This will confirm if the issue is isolated to the external dependency or if there are broader issues affecting the Payment Processing Service.

initial_actions.rationale: This will ensure that the correct team is taking responsibility for resolving the incident.
